hbs.title: State-wise Outstanding Guarantees of State Governments

meta.coverage: State-wise Outstanding Guarantees of State Governments: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 177
meta.note: DBIE report 1718, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor). Periods: as on the date served. Dimensions: none; measures: actual, budget estimate, revised estimate. Andhra Pradesh before 2014-15 is the undivided state, a separate series (Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014; 2014-15 straddles the split). Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
